scope: production services/controller with in-memory repository; no PostgreSQL, network or real provider

results.name: Investment create/sell succeed
Sell ignores client sellPrice=1e12: wallet only gets the server-held value back (no money minted)
User cannot revalue their own investment (update is back-office only)
Sell credits the server-stored value set by admin, not the client figure
Crypto sell = live price x quantity computed on server (0.01 BTC x 3.0e9 VND)
Price source down: 503 and wallet untouched
Loan ignores client interestRate=0 and uses the product rate (18%)
Loan above product maximum -> 400 with errors.amount
Unknown loan product -> 400 with errors.type
TIER_1 outstanding ceiling (100M) blocks 20M + 90M and credits nothing
At most 3 active loans per user
Savings ignores client interestRate=100 and uses the term table (12 months = 7%)
Savings term > 60 -> 400 with errors.term
Receiving 5M does not consume the receiver's own 5M sending limit
Sender over 5M/day -> 403 and balance unchanged
Bank transfer now shares the same daily limit (was unlimited)
daily-summary of the receiver reports only what they sent
Transfer conserves S+R and moves exactly A
Typed validation: amount not a number -> 400 errors.amount, no balance change
Typed validation: amount with decimals -> 400 errors.amount, no balance change
Typed validation: amount below 10.000 -> 400 errors.amount, no balance change
Typed validation: missing recipient -> 400 errors.to_phone, no balance change
Typed validation: two recipients -> 400 errors.to_phone, no balance change
Typed validation: PIN not 6 digits -> 400 errors.pin, no balance change
Well-formed wrong PIN still -> 401 INVALID_PIN (session kept by client)
Financial POST without Idempotency-Key -> 400, nothing debited
Same key + same body replays the receipt and debits once
Same key + different body -> 409
Stored receipt fingerprint no longer covers the PIN
Valid IPN credits once; replay -> 02
Success IPN after expires_at: no credit, order expired + flagged for reconciliation
Tampered amount -> 97
VNPay create: amount > 50M -> 400 errors.amount
VNPay create: malformed billing_period -> 400 errors.billing_period
VNPay create: bill_payment without bill_code -> 400 errors.bill_code
Partial PUT bank updates the field (was 404 because of dangling else)
DELETE bank really removes it (was a silent no-op)
Non-admin cannot enumerate bank accounts via search
Verify returns only payee confirmation fields
Binance price is fetched before Begin(write): no external call while holding the advisory lock
GET /loans/products shows the same rate that loans/create applies
GET /savings/products covers every term 0-60 with the rate create applies
Flexible savings held 3 months pays 12M x 4.2% x 3/12 = 126.000 (was always 0)
PIN hash is read and verified before Begin(write) takes the advisory lock
PIN changed between pre-check and lock is verified again and rejected; balance unchanged
5 wrong PINs lock PIN use (429 PIN_LOCKED), even the correct PIN is refused while locked; no debit
After the lock expires the correct PIN works and the counter is cleared
Wrong PIN message tells how many attempts remain
5 wrong passwords lock the identifier (case-insensitive) for login
Login by phone still works
Google with the email of a password account -> 409, account not linked
A Google-created account signs in again with the same subject
Admin stats, users page and transaction stats keep their shapes
KYC list omits photos (has_images=true); GET /admin/kyc/detail/{id} returns them
